mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT NULLIF(mc.unit_cost, 0) FROM wms_material_cost mc WHERE mc.material_id = f.material_id), (SELECT SUM(pi.amount - pi.tax_amount) / SUM(pi.qty) FROM scm_trade_doc_item pi JOIN scm_trade_doc pd ON pd.id = pi.doc_id WHERE pi.material_id = f.material_id AND pd.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN'), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT d.biz_date AS biz_date, YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date) AS period, d.doc_no AS doc_no, d.partner_id AS customer_id, c.owner_id AS owner_id, i.material_id AS material_id, m.category AS category, COALESCE(i.warehouse_id, d.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id, d.dept_id AS dept_id, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END AS qty, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN i.amount - i.tax_amount ELSE i.tax_amount - i.amount END AS amount, 0 AS cost, 0 AS profit FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_trade_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = d.partner_id WHERE d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN')
mapper.update: UPDATE bi_fact_sales f SET cost = ROUND(f.qty * , 2) WHERE f.id > 0
UPDATE bi_fact_sales SET profit = amount - cost WHERE id > 0
mapper.select: SELECT d.biz_date AS biz_date, YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date) AS period, d.doc_no AS doc_no, d.partner_id AS supplier_id, i.material_id AS material_id, m.category AS category, COALESCE(i.warehouse_id, d.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END AS qty, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' THEN i.amount - i.tax_amount ELSE i.tax_amount - i.amount END AS amount FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_trade_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE d.kind IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN')

SELECT s.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, s.material_id AS material_id, m.category AS category, SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock s JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = s.material_id GROUP BY s.warehouse_id, s.material_id, m.category HAVING SUM(s.qty) <> 0
mapper.update: UPDATE bi_fact_inventory f SET amount = ROUND(f.qty * , 2) WHERE f.snap_date = #{today}
mapper.select: SELECT v.period AS period, e.account_id AS account_id, a.category AS category, e.dept_id AS dept_id, SUM(e.debit) AS debit, SUM(e.credit) AS credit FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.source_type <> 'CLOSE' GROUP BY v.period, e.account_id, a.category, e.dept_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_sales) AS "sales", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_purchase) AS "purchase", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_inventory) AS "inventory", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT snap_date) FROM bi_fact_inventory) AS "snapshots", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bi_fact_finance) AS "finance"
